wayback._note: NEA's site has had four generations on nea.com, and every parsed row carries its own capture URL, so no era needs wayback-pull.py: (1) the ColdFusion site to 2010 (/PortfolioCompanies/ sector pages and the SummaryReports: Current, Historical, Acquisitions, Public Purchase, VGE; /NEATeam/ people), parsed by scratch/old-parse.py (era old-cf) and scratch/old-roster.py; (2) the ASP.NET site 2010-13 (/Portfolio/CompanyDetail.aspx?id=N, /Team/Default.aspx), era old-aspx; (3) the ExpressionEngine and Craft sites 2013-24 (/portfolio/<slug> company pages with the firm's Year invested, Investment Stage, Investment Status and Company Status; /team/<slug>), scratch/cc-parse.py (era cc-company-page) and scratch/cc-roster.py; (4) the Next.js site from 2024, read live through the Statamic API. Common Crawl (scratch/cc-cluster.py, cc-fetch.py, cc-fetch-q.py) carries 2008 on; the Internet Archive carries the years before 2008 and the pages Common Crawl missed (scratch/ia-cdx.py), both through the machine-wide throttles.

roster._note: Provisional: the archived people namespaces are set once the capture paths are read.

sources._note: The live portfolio: every published Statamic `portfolio` entry (917), read through the CMS's public GraphQL endpoint (statamic.nea.com/graphql) by scratch/pull-statamic.py and flattened by scratch/shape-site.py. Per company the firm states its first-investment year, a stage label (Seed / Early / Growth / Public/PIPES, carried as stage_site until scored), its status and exit line, the NEA deal team and NEA board members. Draft entries (10) are not listings.

site_api._note: nea.com is Next.js over Statamic (statamic.nea.com); its GraphQL endpoint answers without a token and serves the portfolio, team, press_releases and content collections.
site_api._entry_stage_note: stage_site is the CMS company_stage: Seed, Early, Growth or Public/PIPES, NEA's own label for its investment (a company's current stage is never 'PIPES'), so it is eligible (decisions.md D6). Early straddles Seed and Series A and is an anchor only; Public/PIPES names no round; Seed and Growth label at MEDIUM confidence: scored 2026-09-30 against documented entry rounds (scratch/stage-score.json), Seed 15/21, Growth 20/25, 35/46 together (76%); Early splits 8 Series A to 6 Series B or later and never labels. The misses are one-directional by size: Seed on small first-priced Series A rounds (TiVo, Data Domain, Tamr, Synlogic), Growth on large Series A rounds (MoonPay, Desire2Learn, Supernus, Monte Rosa), plus two plain mislabels (Tempus, Pair). The field reads as company maturity at entry more than the round's own name. A documented round overrides with stage_disputes_band.
site_api._team_social_overrides_note: search_verified 2026-09-30 (Erik's ruling of 2026-09-30): each link came from a LinkedIn search whose result title names the person and NEA ('<name> - New Enterprise Associates (NEA)'; Mason Murray's 'Principal at NEA'), and each handle names the person. The firm's own team pages carry no personal links for these six. Tony Florence, Scott Sandell, Ali Behbahani, Paul Walker and Claudia Fan Munce stay without a link: their search results did not name the firm in the title.

edgar._seed_queries_note: A company search with exactly one match returns that company's own page, which edgar-entities.py's result regex does not read, so single-match seeds (nea+secondary, nea+bh) add nothing; those vehicles enter through the own pooled Form D fold-in once the roster sweep sees their filings. Write-back proposed at close.
